code_edition.value: 2025 California Electrical Code with 2025 San Francisco Electrical Code Amendments

open_questions: Exact printed revision date and page numbers inside Information Sheet E-02 (https://media.api.sf.gov/documents/IS_E-02.EV.Charging_Final_Signed.pdf) could not be fully verified from indexed PDF excerpts.

DBI Information Sheet E-01 (https://www.sf.gov/sites/default/files/2022-08/IS%20E-01.pdf) retrieved online is a 2019 draft referencing 2016 codes; a 2025-updated version was not indexed to confirm whether any large single-family service upgrades or generators trigger formal electrical plan review.

DBI migrated no-plan electrical permits to PermitSF on September 14, 2026 (https://www.sf.gov/september-14-2026-updates-for-permitsf), while the Homeowner's Electrical Permit Application PDF (https://www.sf.gov/file/homeowners-electrical-permit-application) still references in-person processing and emailing solar applications over 4 kW to DBI.PVPLANS@sfgov.org.

SFFD Administrative Bulletin 5.12 for 2025 (https://sf-fire.org/media/4070) is marked DRAFT in the retrieved PDF, while the live HTML page (https://sf-fire.org/512-energy-storage-systems-r-3-occupancies) still cites the 2022 CFC.
No SF DBI-published residential electrical load calculation worksheet, mandatory NEC 220 method (220.82 vs. 220.83 vs. 220.87), or EV charger service load factor percentage was found on sf.gov.

local_rules.rule: EVSE coupling means must be stored at least 18 inches indoors or 24 inches outdoors
local_rules.quote: The coupling means of the electric vehicle supply equipment must be stored at a height of not less than 18” above the finished floor for indoor locations or 24” above grade for outdoor locations

local_rules.rule: Chargers over 60A or 150V to ground require a line-of-sight disconnect within 50 feet
local_rules.quote: For a charging unit rated at more than 60 amps or more than 150V to ground: The disconnecting means must be provided in a readily accessible location is in line of sight and within 50' of the EVSE

local_rules.rule: Ventilation or battery systems for EV charging trigger electrical and mechanical plan review
local_rules.quote: If ventilation and/or battery systems are required for the charging unit or electrical equipment, an electrical plan review and mechanical plan review are required.

checklist.title: Prepare plans for your solar panel or photovoltaic (PV) system

requirements.item: Roof plan showing modules, conduit routing, disconnects, inverters, service, and subpanels
requirements.quote: Location of modules, junction or combiner boxes, disconnects, inverters, electrical service, and any subpanels relevant to the installation.

requirements.item: Single-line or multi-line wiring diagram with wire/conduit sizes and ampacity calculations
requirements.quote: Include electrical wiring diagram (single or multiple line) showing any: Modules. Inverters. Switches. Panels. Wire types and sizes. Conduit type and sizes. Ampacity calculations.

requirements.item: Current PDF manufacturer data sheets for all major system components
requirements.quote: Include data sheets for any major components used in the system. Provide current PDF downloads from manufacturer websites only.

requirements.item: Warning label and signage sheets for service personnel and emergency responders
requirements.quote: Include sheets with updated warning label and signage for service personnel and emergency responders.

sheet_requirements.sheet_size: 11x17 (larger allowed if needed for detail; indicate intended size)
sheet_requirements.copies_or_format: 1 unlocked PDF file submitted by email; 10 point type size or larger
sheet_requirements.quote: Put all pages into 1 unlocked PDF file. Format pages for printing on 11x17 size paper.

local_rules.rule: Only licensed A, C-10, or C-46 (without battery) contractors may apply for solar/PV permits
local_rules.quote: Only California-licensed contractors with the following license types may apply for a solar permit or an electrical permit for a solar or PV system: A. C-10. C-46 (without an energy storage system / battery)

local_rules.rule: Individual ESS units are limited to 20 kWh and require at least 3 feet of spacing
local_rules.quote: Individual ESS units shall be separated by at least 3 feet of spacing*. Modular ESS products shall be considered as an individual unit and shall be limited to the maximum total individual unit capacity of 20 kWh.

local_rules.rule: ESS in attached garages requires gypsum board dwelling-garage separation per Table R302.6
local_rules.quote: Table R302. 6 requires gypsum board or equivalent to be installed along an entire wall to provide dwelling-garage separation.
